commitResults.messageBody:
Write JSON to a temporary sibling file, then replace the data file with an
atomic move. LogicManager runs persistence-bound commands on a transaction
copy of the model and publishes it only after a successful save, so a failed
save leaves memory, the filtered view, next-ID state and disk bytes unchanged.
Refs #151

commitResults.messageTitle: fix(followup): reject year 0000 in follow-up date command
fix(followup): record previous and new dates and make same-date a no-op
commitResults.messageBody:
Events now carry (type, timestamp, previous date, new date); legacy
single-date JSON is migrated on load. Scheduling the pending date again
adds no event and skips the save. Stored dates outside 0001-9999 and
discontinuous histories are rejected, and a failed load no longer
allows the source file to be overwritten.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: run undo and redo inside the atomic save transaction
commitResults.messageBody:
History now lives on the transaction candidate and is published only after
the file is replaced, so a failed save leaves memory, history and disk
unchanged. Undo and redo reset the filter and comparator so every debtor is
shown in persistent-ID order. Remove the pending-save machinery.
Refs #151
